Alongside the massive Best Buy Labor Day sale, we are also tracking thousands of deals in Amazon’s sale event including today’s headliner deal – AirPods Pro 3 are now back down at $50 off. That offer joins the ongoing all-time low on AirTag 2 at $20 each and a sizable M5 MacBook Air re-stock in the official Apple Refurb Store (more details on those right here). We have the going M6 Mac mini pre-order discounts alongside a series of official Apple accessories from $5.50 today – USB-C cables, Apple Watch bands, and more. Check it all out below.

Best Buy’s giant 2026 Labor Day sale is now live: Apple, Android phones, appliances $1,100 off, TVs, more

Amazon’s massive 2026 Labor Day sale now live! Thousands of deals: Apple, Android, TVs, tech under $100, more from under $5

AirPods Pro 3 now $50 off in Amazon’s giant Labor Day sale

As part of its now live Labor Day sale, Amazon has now dropped the price on Apple’s latest AirPods Pro 3 back down to $199 shipped.

Amazon is now offering the latest and greatest AirPods Pro 3 at $199 – that’s a straight up $50 off the list price and the best around in brand new condition.

Regularly $249, we are looking at a solid 20% price drop here landing within just $10 of the best we have tracked over the last couple months.

We did catch a notable deal at $190 landing in early August, but that deal is long gone now and we are talking about an offer within just $9 here right now.

Amazon bumped the price back up very close to the MSRP at the tail end of last month, and that was after it launched its massive Labor Day sale event. It very much appeared as though it was not going to be offering any notable discounts on AirPods Pro 3 for its 2026 Labor Day sale, but that all changes here today.

Apple deals starting to disappear, grab AirTag 2 at the best price ever ($20 each)

  • AirTag 2 $24 (Reg. $29) – Matching all-time low
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $80 (Reg. $99) – NEW all-time low

M6 Mac mini pre-order discounts live at Amazon ahead of delivery this month

Alongside the Labor Day sales now live at Best Buy and Amazon, we are moving closer to delivery day on the all-new M6 Mac mini and M5 Pro model. If you’re still considering a pre-order, scoop up the new $9 Apple Polishing Cloth before it sells out and check out the discounts Amazon is offering on Apple’s new Mac mini pre-orders.

We have already highlighted these deals in various posts as they went live, but we wanted to make sure they were all in one place and on the radar for folks still considering a pre-order ahead of this month’s delivery date:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $880 (Reg. $899)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,070 (Reg. $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,299
  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB $1,669 (Reg. $1,699)

Official Apple refurb store re-stocks M5 MacBook Air, most affordable models up to $240 off

The official Apple Certified Refurbished Store has just re-stocked loads of M5 MacBook Air models as of this morning. This includes a pair of the most affordable models you can buy, like entry model and the 16GB/1TB at $240 off, as well as a host of upgraded and 15-inch variants.

As we have detailed previously, stock can sell out very quickly on the official Apple refurb store, and for good reason – it has, lately, delivered the lowest prices around on current-generation MacBook Air models and loads of them just came back in stock.

You will find all of the models available at this link – click the MacBook Air option on the left hand side of the page to see everything. But we will focus on the two most likely to sell out the fastest as they are the most affordable:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (Reg. $1,299)
  • Starlight and Sky Blue
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,359 (Reg. $1,599)
  • Midnight, Starlight, Sky Blue

Get in there while you can if you’re interested – both of these machines are far more expensive at Amazon in new condition right now.

Official Apple accessories from $5.50 today: USB-C cables, Apple Watch bands, more

Alongside the Amazon Labor Day sale, today Woot has launched a wide-ranging Apple sale with an extra 10% off at checkout. Loaded with iPad and MacBook models, it also features a series of notable discounts on official Apple accessories – USB-C cables, MagSafe 3 cables, Apple Watch bands, and more. On top of the already discounted rates, you can also use code APPLETEN at checkout for an extra 10% off items in this sale – just note there’s a limit of one coupon use per customer.

While you will find a host of refurbished gear here, including iPads and MacBooks, as well as some deep deals on previous-generation gear, there are also a host of notable discounts on accessories – this is typically where the best values are in these sales for folks not interested in the refurbs.

      Apple’s MagSafe Battery now back at $59 all-time low, or $39 via Amazon Resale

      As part of Amazon’s massive Labor Day sale event and the ongoing all-time low on AirTag 2, we are also getting some notable discounts on the official Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery. You’ll find it in brand new condition down at 40% off or as low as $39 via Amazon Resale.

      Amazon is now offering the official Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery in brand new condition down at $59 shipped.

      That’s a solid deal for sure, but we are also catching an ongoing offer courtesy of Amazon Resale on Like New units down even lower than that:

      Amazon’s best quality “Like-New” listing a go, it is offering the official Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery down at just $38.74 – Go hit this link and choose the “Resale – Like New” listing – it will drop an additional 20% at checkout to deliver the lowest price we have tracked from a reputable source.

      iPhone Air is $150 off this week, but ‘excellent’ open-box listings are up to $359 off at Best Buy

      As part of its now live 2026 Labor Day Sale, Best Buy is delivering the best deal around on brand new unlocked iPhone Air units with just about every model at $150 off the list price. However, you can save even more than that right now with its “excellent” condition open-box units – they are up to $359 off the new list prices. Details below.

      Firstly, here’s how pricing lands on brand new condition units:

      • iPhone Air 256GB $850 (Reg. $999)
      • iPhone Air 512GB $1,050 (Reg. $1,199)
      • iPhone Air 1TB $1,250 (Reg. $1,400)

      These are the best deals we can find on brand new condition unlocked iPhone Air units right now from a reputable retailer. As a quick reminder, Amazon does not carry iPhone Air in new condition.

      But as mentioned above, Best Buy is also delivering these unlocked units in “excellent” open-box condition right now at even lower prices. You can browse through all of the open-box listings on this page via the “More options” link on each model right here, but we have pulled some highlights below at up to $359 off the new list prices:

      • Open-box iPhone Air 256GB Space Black $807 (Reg. $999)
      • Open-box iPhone Air 512GB Sky Blue $840 (Reg. $1,199)
      • Open-box iPhone Air 512GB Space Black $997 (Reg. $1,199)

      Land a set of current-gen Beats Solo Buds for just $35 today

      While its massive Labor Day sale is now in full swing, Best Buy’s “excellent” condition open-box units are a fantastic way to score deep deals on tech and they have been particular notable with Beats headphones and earbuds this year. This morning we spotted one of the best we have ever tracked – you can land the regularly $79 Beats Solo Buds in Transparent Red for just $35.

      Best Buy is now offering “excellent” condition open-box Beats Solo Buds in the Transparent Red colorway down at just $34.99 shipped. The open-box set in Matte Black is selling for $46 right now.

      Sonos officially unveils next-gen Ace Ultra Headphones with 2x ANC, pre-orders now live

      Update: The new Sonos Ace Ultra headphones are now available for pre-order on Amazon as well.

      Just as the early leaks suggested, not only has Sonos been working on next-generation over-ear headphones, but the new Ace Ultra Headphones are indeed now up for pre-order on the official site.

      Today’s accessories and charging deals:

      • Anker’s 3-port 100W Prime USB-C charger hits one of its lowest prices for Labor Day (42% off)
      • Spigen Enzo Aramid and metal iPhone 17 Case drops to $31 Amazon low
      • Amazon Anker Labor Day sale now live at up to 42% off! Deals on chargers, power banks, Qi2.2 gear, more from just $12
      • ecobee’s Smart Thermostat Essential just dropped even lower, now at $90 Amazon low (36% off)
      • Amazon’s Labor Day Sale returns Yeedi’s S14 Plus robot with a self-cleaning roller mop to its $400 low ($300 off), more from $280
      • Labor Day Blink smart home deals: Score two indoor cams at $19 each, video doorbell for $48, more
      • One of the best Labor Day Qi2.2 power bank deals drops this 10,000mAh Baseus model to just $33 (52% off)
      • Score Anker’s 45W Nano Smart Display charger at its best price in Labor Day sale (All colors)
      • This magnetic Apple Watch band just plunged to $14 Prime shipped (Reg. $29)

      iPhone 17 Pro models drop to new Amazon all-time lows again at up to $285 off (Renewed Premium)

      Alongside the Labor Day sale at Best Buy with deals on iPhone Air, and Amazon’s massive sale event, we are catching some solid discounts on iPhone 17 Pro as well. While not all color and configs are down quite as low as they were last week, we are now tracking new Amazon all-time low pricing on its best quality Renewed Premium iPhone 17 Pro models at up to $285 off. Apple will unleash the new iPhone 18 Pro models very soon, but you can bet they are going to be a whole lot more expensive than this.

      As I have said previously, Amazon Renewed Premium units are the best way to land a deal on current-generation iPhone units, and especially iPhone 17 Pro right now. Apple does not sell them in the official refurb store, and even once it does, the prices are rarely ever as low as Amazon:

      • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,214 (Reg. $1,499 new) – New all-time low
      • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,214 (Reg. $1,499 new) – all-time low
      • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (Reg. $1,499 new)
      • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,149 (Reg. $1,299 new) – New all-time low
      • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,165 (Reg. $1,299 new) – New all-time low
      • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,171 (Reg. $1,299 new)

      All of these units come with a full 1-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee and “greater than 90% original battery life.” Just make sure you use the links above and watch out for third-party sellers otherwise.

      Sony’s 2026 BRAVIA 7 II HDR Google TV with Gemini is $800 off for Labor Day

      Alongside major events at Best Buy and Amazon, the official Sony site is running an impressive Labor Day sale of its own headlined by some of its 2026 BRAVIA TVs. Joining deals on some its latest headphones, DSLR/mirrorless cameras, and more, we are also tracking up to $800 off its latest 2026 BRAVIA 7 II and BRAVIA 8 II smart TVs.

      For me, it is the 2026 BRAVIA 7 II that hits the sweet spot among the options live right now in the Sony sale. Some people swear by these Sony displays, and after experiencing this one for myself, I can see why – they are just super nice TVs and the last one I owned lasted for years.

      There are deals across all sizes right now, but it’s that 65-incher catching my eye – it is now $800 off the list price, complete with Sony’s True RGB tech, Dolby Vision, Dolby Atmos, IMAX Enhanced, and DTS:X support, as well as Apple AirPlay 2, Google Cast, and Google Gemini action:

      • BRAVIA 7 II 65-inch RGB 4K HDR Google TV with Gemini $1,800 (Reg. $2,600)

      Wild deals live on Apple gear via Amazon Resale: Up to 60% off MagSafe Battery, AirPods, Apple Pencil, more

      Amazon’s 2026 Labor Day is seriously flying now and, while there are some great deals live on brand new condition gear, there are some wild discounts on Apple gear courtesy of Amazon Resale right now – it is offering up to an additional 30% off gear at checkout. Details below.

      The all-time low pricing on AirTag 2 from $20 each is still live alongside the AirPods Pro 3 deal and the early M6 Mac mini pre-order discounts, but there are also some seriously notable deals around right now on Apple accessories if you’re quick.

      All of the deals below come in the form of Amazon Resale offers in the best quality it offers:

      • AirPods 4 $80 (Reg. $129 new)
      • Apple Pencil Pro $74 shipped (Reg. $129 new)
      • Apple Pencil USB-C $55 (Reg. $69)
      • iPhone Air MagSafe Battery $39 (Reg. $99 new)
        • Currently on sale for $59 new

      These deals don’t normally last for very long in Like: New condition, so you’ll want to scope them out as soon as possible.

      ***Note: Opt for the “Resale – Like New” listings once you have clicked through the links above.
